Estpolis Denki - Yomigaeru Densetsu.name: Lufia: The Legend Returns
Estpolis Denki - Yomigaeru Densetsu.summary: The island of the Sinistrals, Doom Island, sank deep into the sea after the second Doom Island War. It was believed to be in an eternal sleep, but has once again begun silently beating, preparing to make its appearance in the sky for the third time. The evil Sinistrals have again been resurrected and released an unforseen terror on the land. A force has awaken witin you... a spiritual flow that draws you to a conflict that will save the world! The power of Maxim's legendary bloodline lives in you... The thread of destiny guides you through an adventurous journey looking for an unknown destination!

Sutte Hakkun GB.name: Sutte Hakkun GB
Sutte Hakkun GB.summary:
Sutte Hakkun GB is an unreleased game for the Game Boy and Game Boy Color, compatible with the Super Game Boy.
Both this game and Sutte Hakkun (an earlier cancelled Sutte Hakkun Game Boy port) were found in the Nintendo Gigaleak in 2020.

The game has different levels when comparing to the previous versions.
